title: Fix an off-by-one in range()
prompt: src/range.js exports range(start, end). It should return the integers from start up to but NOT including end (like Python's range). It currently includes end. Fix the bug.
acceptance: range(start, end) excludes end [tests: excludes the end, handles negatives]
range returns [] when start >= end [tests: empty when start equals end, empty when start is after end]
